night_start.tl: Lumulubog na ang araw. Hanggang umaga, kapit lang!
night_start.en: The sun is setting. Hold on until morning!

tabi_tabi.tl: Tabi-tabi po! Narinig tayo ng mga duwende, mukhang mabait sila ngayong gabi.
tabi_tabi.en: Excuse us, spirits! The duwende heard us, and they seem kind tonight.

spawn_aswang.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa hilaga. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang.en: An aswang is coming from the north. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_north.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa hilaga. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_north.en: An aswang is coming from the north. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_east.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa silangan. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_east.en: An aswang is coming from the east. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_south.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa timog. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_south.en: An aswang is coming from the south. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_west.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa kanluran. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_west.en: An aswang is coming from the west. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_tikbalang.en: Feel those footsteps? That's a tikbalang.

spawn_kapre.tl: Amoy tabako... may kapre sa puno.
spawn_kapre.en: Smells like tobacco... there's a kapre in the tree.

spawn_duwende.tl: Ingat sa anting-anting, may maliit na kamay na gustong humawak.
spawn_duwende.en: Guard the charm, a little hand wants it.

last_turn.tl: Huling dilim na. Konting tiis na lang!
last_turn.en: Last stretch of dark. Just a little longer!

win.tl: Sumikat na ang araw! Ligtas ang baryo.
win.en: The sun is up. The barrio is safe.

lose.tl: Nasira ang kubo... Subukan ulit bukas ng gabi.
lose.en: The kubo fell... Try again tomorrow night.

quiet.tl: Tahimik ang gabi. Hinga muna, tapos handa ulit.
quiet.en: The night is quiet. Breathe, then get ready again.

quiet.tl: Umiihip ang hangin sa bukid. Abangan ang susunod.
quiet.en: The wind stirs over the fields. Watch for what comes next.

quiet.tl: Walang gumagalaw sa dilim. Sa ngayon.
quiet.en: Nothing moves in the dark. For now.
